ex.en: Do you have your student identification card?
ex.zh: 你有帶學生證嗎？

ex.en: Please bring a valid form of identification.
ex.zh: 請攜帶有效的身分證明文件。

identification.en: an official paper or card that shows who you are

ex.en: Early identification of problems saves time and money.
ex.zh: 及早發現問題可以省時又省錢。

ex.en: The identification of the missing files took hours.
ex.zh: 找出遺失的檔案花了好幾個小時。

identification.en: the act of recognizing who or what someone or something is

ex.en: Ideally, a candidate for this job should have four years' work experience.
ex.zh: 理想情況下，這份工作的應徵者應具備四年工作經驗。

ex.en: Ideally, we should finish the project by Friday.
ex.zh: 理想的話，我們應該在星期五前完成這個專案。

ideally.en: used to say how things would be in the best situation

ex.en: The hotel is ideally located near the station.
ex.zh: 這家飯店位置絕佳，就在車站附近。

ex.en: She is ideally suited for the job.
ex.zh: 她非常適合這份工作。

ideally.en: in a perfect way for a certain purpose

identical.zh: 完全相同的、一模一樣的

ex.en: He is identical to his older brother.
ex.zh: 他和哥哥長得一模一樣。

ex.en: The two reports are almost identical.
ex.zh: 這兩份報告幾乎一模一樣。

ex.en: They are identical twins.
ex.zh: 他們是同卵雙胞胎。

identical.en: exactly the same as another person or thing

ex.en: It's wasteful to leave the land lying idle.
ex.zh: 讓土地閒置很浪費。

ex.en: Half of the machines in the factory are idle.
ex.zh: 工廠裡有一半的機器閒置著。

ex.en: Jim works hard, but John is idle.
ex.zh: 吉姆工作努力，約翰卻無所事事。

ex.en: No matter how rich a man may be, he ought not to be idle.
ex.zh: 一個人無論多有錢，都不應該遊手好閒。

idle.en: not working and not wanting to work

ex.en: Don't leave your car engine idling.
ex.zh: 不要讓車子引擎一直怠速空轉。

ex.en: The bus idled outside the hotel.
ex.zh: 巴士在飯店外怠速等候。

idle.en: to run an engine without moving the vehicle

ex.en: The two parties have deep ideological differences.
ex.zh: 兩黨之間有很深的意識形態分歧。

ex.en: Their disagreement is more ideological than practical.
ex.zh: 他們的分歧與其說是實務上的，不如說是理念上的。

ideological.en: based on a set of political or social beliefs

ex.en: The heart of Esperanto ideology is the equality of all languages and cultures.
ex.zh: 世界語理念的核心是所有語言和文化一律平等。

ex.en: The party's ideology has changed over time.
ex.zh: 這個政黨的意識形態隨著時間改變了。

ideology.en: a set of beliefs that a group or person has about how society should be

ex.en: How did you come up with this crazy idea?
ex.zh: 你是怎麼想到這麼瘋狂的主意的？

ex.en: Get rid of those kinds of naive ideas.
ex.zh: 別再有那種天真的想法了。

ex.en: That's a great idea!
ex.zh: 這是個好主意！

idea.en: a plan or thought in your mind

ex.en: I have no idea why she got so angry.
ex.zh: 我不知道她為什麼那麼生氣。

ex.en: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?
ex.zh: 你知道銀行幾點關門嗎？

idea.en: to not know anything about something

ex.en: This chart will give you an idea of our sales.
ex.zh: 這張圖表能讓你大致了解我們的業績。

ex.en: Can you give me a rough idea of the cost?
ex.zh: 你能告訴我大概的費用嗎？

ex.en: You can identify children's voices without any problem.
ex.zh: 你可以毫不費力地辨認出孩子們的聲音。

ex.en: She identified him as the murderer.
ex.zh: 她指認他就是兇手。

identify.en: to recognize who or what someone or something is

ex.en: They identified the risk factors.
ex.zh: 他們找出了風險因素。

ex.en: We need to identify the cause of the problem.
ex.zh: 我們需要找出問題的原因。

identify.en: to find and name a problem or cause

ex.en: Many viewers identify with the main character.
ex.zh: 許多觀眾對主角很有共鳴。

ex.en: I can really identify with her feelings.
ex.zh: 我很能體會她的感受。

identify.en: to feel that you understand and share the feelings of someone

ex.en: Sir, please present your passport or identity card, so I can register it.
ex.zh: 先生，請出示護照或身分證，讓我幫您登記。

ex.en: A student should not lose sight of his own identity.
ex.zh: 學生不應該忘了自己的身分。

ex.en: Please bring a photo ID to prove your identity.
ex.zh: 請攜帶附照片的證件以證明身分。

identity.en: who a person is, or the name and details that show it

ex.en: The company needs a strong brand identity.
ex.zh: 公司需要鮮明的品牌識別。

ex.en: Language is an important part of cultural identity.
ex.zh: 語言是文化認同的重要部分。

identity.en: the qualities that make a person or group different from others

ex.en: A warm, sunny day is ideal for a picnic.
ex.zh: 溫暖的晴天最適合野餐。

ex.en: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
ex.zh: 海灘是孩子們玩耍的理想場所。

ex.en: He proved to be an ideal husband.
ex.zh: 結果證明他是個理想的丈夫。

ideal.en: perfect, or the best possible for a purpose

ex.en: She has always had high ideals.
ex.zh: 她一向有崇高的理想。

ex.en: The company was founded on the ideal of equal opportunity.
ex.zh: 這家公司以機會平等的理想創立。

ideal.en: a high standard or perfect example that you try to reach

ex.en: Strong passwords can help prevent identity theft.
ex.zh: 使用高強度密碼有助於防止身分盜用。

ex.en: The bank contacted customers after an identity theft case.
ex.zh: 發生身分盜用案件後，銀行聯絡了客戶。

identity theft.en: the crime of using another person's private details to pretend to be them

ex.en: I felt like an idiot when I locked my keys in the car.
ex.zh: 我把鑰匙鎖在車裡時，覺得自己像個笨蛋。

ex.en: Don't call people an idiot; it is rude and hurtful.
ex.zh: 別罵人是笨蛋，那樣既無禮又傷人。

ex.en: Each student has a unique identifier number.
ex.zh: 每位學生都有一個獨一無二的識別號碼。

ex.en: Choose a clear identifier for each variable in your code.
ex.zh: 請為程式中的每個變數選擇一個清楚的識別名稱。

ex.en: The thief was easily identifiable by his red hat.
ex.zh: 那個小偷戴著紅帽子，很容易辨認。

ex.en: Each product has an identifiable number on the label.
ex.zh: 每項產品的標籤上都有可辨識的編號。

ex.en: Please show your id at the entrance.
ex.zh: 請在入口處出示您的證件。

ex.en: You need a photo id to pick up the package.
ex.zh: 領取包裹需要附照片的證件。

ex.en: Enter your user id and password to log in.
ex.zh: 請輸入您的使用者帳號和密碼以登入。

ex.en: Each student has a unique id number.
ex.zh: 每位學生都有一組獨一無二的識別號碼。

ex.en: Freud said the id seeks immediate pleasure.
ex.zh: 佛洛伊德認為本我追求即時的滿足。

ex.en: In his theory, the id, ego, and superego work together.
ex.zh: 在他的理論中，本我、自我和超我共同運作。

ex.en: She hung posters of her favorite idol on the bedroom wall.
ex.zh: 她把最喜歡的偶像海報貼在臥室牆上。

ex.en: Many teenagers want to meet their idols in person.
ex.zh: 許多青少年希望能親眼見到自己的偶像。

ex.en: The ancient temple once held a golden idol.
ex.zh: 那座古老的神廟曾供奉一尊金色神像。

ex.en: Some people make an idol of money and forget what matters.
ex.zh: 有些人把金錢當成崇拜的對象，忘了真正重要的事。

ex.en: "Break the ice" is an idiom that means to start a conversation.
ex.zh: 「break the ice」是一句慣用語，意思是打破僵局開啟話題。

ex.en: It is hard to translate an idiom word for word.
ex.zh: 慣用語很難逐字翻譯。

ex.en: The teacher taught us a new idiom each week.
ex.zh: 老師每週教我們一個新的慣用語。

ex.en: His idealism led him to work for a charity after college.
ex.zh: 他的理想主義使他大學畢業後去慈善機構工作。

ex.en: Young people are often full of idealism.
ex.zh: 年輕人常常充滿理想主義。

ex.en: The writer has an idiosyncratic style that is easy to recognize.
ex.zh: 這位作家的風格很獨特，一眼就能認出來。

ex.en: Her idiosyncratic way of filing papers confused her coworkers.
ex.zh: 她獨特的文件歸檔方式讓同事很困惑。

ex.en: She is young and idealistic and wants to change the world.
ex.zh: 她年輕又有理想，想要改變世界。

ex.en: His plan sounds idealistic and hard to carry out.
ex.zh: 他的計畫聽起來很理想化，難以實行。

ex.en: He sat idly by the window and watched the rain.
ex.zh: 他閒閒地坐在窗邊看雨。

ex.en: We can't stand idly by while others need our help.
ex.zh: 別人需要我們幫忙時，我們不能袖手旁觀。

ex.en: The two parties are ideologically far apart.
ex.zh: 這兩個政黨在意識形態上差距很大。

ex.en: She is ideologically opposed to the plan.
ex.zh: 她在思想上就反對這項計畫。

idyllic.zh: 田園詩般的；悠閒愜意的

ex.en: We spent an idyllic week in a small village by the sea.
ex.zh: 我們在海邊的小村莊度過了愜意如詩的一週。

ex.en: The farm looked idyllic in the soft morning light.
ex.zh: 在柔和的晨光中，那座農場宛如田園畫。

ex.en: He spent the summer in idleness, doing nothing at all.
ex.zh: 他整個夏天都閒著無所事事。

ex.en: Long periods of idleness can make people feel bored.
ex.zh: 長時間的閒散會讓人覺得無聊。

ideologue.zh: 意識形態的信奉者；理論家

ex.en: He is an ideologue who refuses to accept any opposing view.
ex.zh: 他是個死守意識形態、不肯接受任何不同看法的人。

ex.en: The party's leading ideologue wrote most of its speeches.
ex.zh: 該黨的首席理論家寫了大部分的演講稿。

identified.zh: 辨認出；確認（identify 的過去式）

ex.en: Police identified the driver from the camera footage.
ex.zh: 警方從監視器畫面中辨認出了那名駕駛。

ex.en: The doctor identified the cause of her cough.
ex.zh: 醫師找出了她咳嗽的原因。

ex.en: The identified suspect was taken in for questioning.
ex.zh: 已確認身分的嫌疑人被帶去訊問。

ex.en: Several identified problems still need to be fixed.
ex.zh: 幾個已確認的問題仍需要修正。

ex.en: That was an idiotic mistake, and I'm sorry.
ex.zh: 那是個愚蠢的錯誤，我很抱歉。

ex.en: Leaving the door open all night was idiotic.
ex.zh: 整晚把門開著實在很蠢。

ex.en: We tend to idealize our childhood memories.
ex.zh: 我們往往會把童年回憶理想化。

ex.en: Don't idealize your boss; everyone makes mistakes.
ex.zh: 別把你的老闆理想化，每個人都會犯錯。

ex.en: My brother is an idealist who believes people are basically good.
ex.zh: 我哥哥是個理想主義者，相信人本質上是善良的。

ex.en: Don't be such an idealist; money matters too.
ex.zh: 別這麼理想主義，錢也很重要。

ex.en: He has an idealist view of how schools should work.
ex.zh: 他對學校應該如何運作抱持理想主義的看法。

ex.en: Her idealist attitude inspired the whole team.
ex.zh: 她理想主義的態度激勵了整個團隊。

ex.en: Many teenagers idolize famous singers.
ex.zh: 許多青少年崇拜知名歌手。

ex.en: He idolized his older brother as a child.
ex.zh: 他小時候把哥哥當成偶像。

ex.en: One of his idiosyncrasies is eating dessert first.
ex.zh: 他的怪癖之一是先吃甜點。

ex.en: Every writer has a few idiosyncrasies in their style.
ex.zh: 每位作家的風格都有一些獨特之處。

idyll.zh: 田園詩；寧靜美好的田園生活

ex.en: Their life in the small village was a perfect idyll.
ex.zh: 他們在小村莊的生活宛如一幅完美的田園畫。

ex.en: The poet wrote an idyll about shepherds and green hills.
ex.zh: 詩人寫了一首描寫牧羊人與青山的田園詩。

identifying.zh: 辨認、找出（identify 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The police are identifying the owner of the lost bag.
ex.zh: 警方正在確認那只遺失背包的主人。

ex.en: Identifying your strengths can help you choose a career.
ex.zh: 找出自己的優勢有助於選擇職業。
